owner: all jv copies sharing an allocated payload
release_rule: jv_copy increments the pointed-to count; jv_free performs kind-specific decrement and final release
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_invalid_free decrements it and releases the allocation when it reaches zero
author: yevbar

release_rule: final jvp_invalid_free calls jv_free on errmsg
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_number_free decrements it and releases the allocation when it reaches zero
author: yevbar

release_rule: lazily allocated on first literal request and freed by final jvp_number_free
author: yevbar

release_rule: valid only during conversion; jvp_literal_number_new parses it and retains no input pointer
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_array_free decrements it and releases elements plus allocation when it reaches zero
author: yevbar

release_rule: final jvp_array_free calls jv_free on every backing element
author: yevbar

release_rule: the view shares the refcounted backing allocation; slicing changes offset and size without copying the allocation
author: yevbar

release_rule: on success the input jv is stored directly; error paths call jv_free on it
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_string_free decrements it and releases the allocation when it reaches zero
author: yevbar

release_rule: released with the enclosing jvp_string allocation after the final decrement
author: yevbar

release_rule: no refcount is added; the pointer aliases payload data and must not outlive release or in-place mutation
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_object_free decrements it and releases occupied slots plus allocation when it reaches zero
author: yevbar

release_rule: final object release or deletion decrements the string payload; rehash transfers the reference without decrement
author: yevbar

release_rule: final object release or deletion calls jv_free; rehash transfers the reference without decrement
author: yevbar

release_rule: new keys are stored directly; an incoming duplicate key is released
author: yevbar

release_rule: the overwritten slot is released and the input value is stored directly
author: yevbar

release_rule: jvp_object_write returns failure before storing or releasing the key, and jv_object_set releases only the object
author: yevbar

release_rule: jv_object_set returns an invalid value without storing or releasing the input value when jvp_object_write fails
author: yevbar
